chunks: Abu al-Abbas al-Kufi narrated to me from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Abu Dawud al-Mustariq, from Abdullah ibn Muskān, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Whoever visits the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him), knowing his right, Allah will record him among those in A'alla 'Illiyin.

key_terms.أَعْلَى عِلِّيِّينَ: The highest register / ranks of Paradise

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the grave of Imam Husayn with knowledge of his rights?
ai.summary: Recorded in Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, this hadith links the physical act of visiting Imam al-Husayn’s grave with spiritual recognition (*ma'rifa*), elevating the visitor to the highest celestial registers. This concept of *A'alla 'Illiyin* (the highest ranks) underscores the Shia belief that the Ahl al-Bayt serve as the divine axis connecting earthly devotion to the ultimate proximity to God.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 4. Abul ‘Abbās Al-Kūfi narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn Ḥusain, from Abī Dāwūd Al-Mustariq, from ‘Abdillāh ibn Muskān, from some of our companions, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:
Those who go to (the Ziyārah of) the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) knowing his rights will be registered among those (who will be) in A’lā ‘Illīyyīn.
